title: SaveCapture
description: Request body for POST /saves. Deliberately minimal: capture always succeeds; extraction is enrichment. Duplicate canonicalized URLs return `409 already_saved` unless `force=true`.

source_app.description: Sharing app name; free-form. Default `unknown` when not sent (e.g. manual paste).

suggested_folder_id.description: One-tap folder chip chosen at capture time, if any.

force.description: Save a second copy of an already-captured link instead of 409.
